## Mechanism

**Server-Sent Events (SSE)** over a long-lived HTTP GET to `/api/v1/sse`.

- Server sets `Content-Type: text/event-stream` and writes `data: {json}\n\n` frames (`sse_handler.go`).
- In-memory pub/sub: handlers call `SSEHub.Broadcast`, which pushes JSON to subscribed clients; slow clients drop events rather than block (`sse_hub.go`).
- Browser uses `fetch("/api/v1/sse", { Accept: "text/event-stream", Authorization: "Bearer …" })` and reads the stream in `useLiveMemoRefresh` (`web/src/hooks/useLiveMemoRefresh.ts`) — not `EventSource`, so Bearer auth works.

Event types (`sse_hub.go`):

| Type | Constant |
|------|----------|
| `memo.created` | `SSEEventMemoCreated` |
| `memo.updated` | `SSEEventMemoUpdated` |
| `memo.deleted` | `SSEEventMemoDeleted` |
| `memo.comment.created` | `SSEEventMemoCommentCreated` |
| `reaction.upserted` | `SSEEventReactionUpserted` |
| `reaction.deleted` | `SSEEventReactionDeleted` |
